app.title: MicroLLM Lab – Try 7 tiny LLM's in the browser
app.author: logicallee
app.description: MicroLLM Lab is a web-based playground that loads and runs seven lightweight LLMs entirely in the browser using WebAssembly and ONNX.
proposed_tests: Navigate to the page and confirm the page loads within 5 seconds.
Select each of the seven LLMs, trigger a prompt, and record response latency.
Verify that the inference output matches the expected reference output for a known prompt.
Measure total memory usage of the browser tab after loading all models.
